1.text: Uwiteka ari ku ngoma, isi yishime,Ibirwa binezerwe uko bingana.

2.text: Ibicu n'umwijima biramukikiza,Gukiranuka no guca imanza zitabera ni imfatiro z'intebe ye.

3.text: Umuriro uramubanziriza,Ugatwika ababisha be impande zose.

4.text: Imirabyo ye yamurikiye isi,Ubutaka burabireba buhinda umushyitsi.

5.text: Imisozi iyagira nk'ibimamāra imbere y'Uwiteka,Imbere y'Umwami w'isi yose.

6.text: Ijuru rivuga gukiranuka kwe,Amahanga yose yarebye ubwiza bwe.

7.text: Abasenga ibishushanyo bibajwe,Bakirata iby'ubusa bamware,Ibigirwamana byose biramuramya.

8.text: Siyoni yarabyumvise iranezerwa,Abakobwa ba Yuda bishimishwa n'imanza zawe zitabera, Uwiteka.

9.text: Kuko wowe Uwiteka usumba byose,Ugategeka isi yose,Ushyizwe hejuru cyane y'ibigirwamana byose.

10.text: Mwa bakunda Uwiteka mwe, mwange ibibi,Arinda ubugingo bw'abakunzi be,Abakiza amaboko y'abanyabyaha.

11.text: Umucyo ubibirwa umukiranutsi,Umunezero ubibirwa abafite imitima itunganye.

12.text: Mwa bakiranutsi mwe, mwishimire Uwiteka,Kandi mushime izina rye, ari ryo rwibutso rwo kwera kwe.
